long_biography.plain_text:
Beattie entered retail through WH Smith before establishing and selling a newsagency business. Moving to Australia in 1978 introduced him to continuity promotions—collectable campaigns designed to increase repeat shopping—and led to co-founding Wallace International. He later returned to London to run its expanding overseas network.

In 1991 he established TCC, extending the model across Europe, North America and Asia before settling in Hong Kong. The company combines licensed products, shopper data and campaign design for large retailers. His later projects pair business with philanthropy. TCC Foundation supports children's programmes, while the Aquos Foundation funds reef rehabilitation, marine research and habitat protection around Banwa Private Island in the Philippines.
